_comment: Agent Commander settings. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. README.md in this folder explains every option. After saving, open the menu again (or choose Reload).

projects._comment: Change the folder to one of your projects.
projects.name: My app

routines.title: Review my uncommitted changes
routines.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this repo. Point out bugs and risky spots, but don't edit anything.

routines._comment: confirm asks you this before starting, with Start and Cancel buttons.
routines.title: Draft release notes
routines.prompt: Draft release notes from the commits since the last tag. Show them to me before saving anything.
routines.confirm: Is everything for this release committed?

routines._comment: A null prompt means Agent Commander asks you what to do each time.
routines.title: Something else…
Check for broken links
routines.prompt: Find broken links on the site and list them with the page they're on. Don't change anything yet.

routines._comment: Routines out here don't belong to a project, so they need their own folder.
routines.title: Tidy my Downloads folder
routines.prompt: Suggest how to tidy this folder. List the moves you'd make and wait for my OK before changing anything.
